question: How do I apply to Academic City University?
answer: Applications are submitted online at https://admissions.acity.edu.gh/undergraduate for undergraduate programmes, or https://admissions.acity.edu.gh/postgraduate for graduate programmes. question: What is the grading scale at ACity?
